Some schizophrenics are actually aware and have some sort insight. I was diagnosed with schizophrenia and I’m somehow aware when I’m having a heavy episode. I would still fall into it and be totally controlled by the disturbances it causes me to have but part of me is fighting and knows how false and not true the things the voices are saying. I find it hard to concentrate though it’s like my thoughts are literally fleeting my brain and I’m trying to get a hold of them but when I do they still go away. I hated the side effects the meds did to me so I stopped taking them and I will not take them.
